method: deterministic grouped quantization and finite affine reconstruction;not circuit simulation or application accuracy qualification

limitations: Nominal10bit deterministic quantization with existing affine offset reconstruction can turn a positive small dot product negative.
No clipping in nominal deterministic test vectors does not certify small-signal or cancellation accuracy.
Approximately8ENOB describes a resolution scale,not an8bit quantizer,noise model or application error guarantee.

reconstruction_convention.ADC_code_step_definition: full_scale/2**bits;nearest code with half-up ties,clipped to0..2**bits-1
reconstruction_convention.calibration_offset_format: signed Q12.12,24bits,count;zero for the ideal nominal device diagnostic
reconstruction_convention.reconstruction: quantize each4x4 digit pair per1152-row group;apply finite gain/offset;round count to nearest integer;merge base4 weight digits;accumulate input digits/groups;apply exact digital offset correction
reconstruction_convention.scope: deterministic ideal device current;finite nominal ADC and declared fixed-point convention;no invented device/noise statistics

ENOB_resolution_scale_only.interpretation: Resolution magnitude only;ENOB is not actual code width,a deterministic error bound or a noise distribution. No8bit ADC simulation is substituted.
